item.title: All Big Poe locations in Zelda Ocarina of Time
item.description: Big Poes are large ghosts that are hiding around Hyrule Field in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake. Like regular Poes, you can store Big Poes in bottles, and sell them to the Poe Collector in Hyrule Castle Town. However, Big Poes are worth a whopping 30 rupees, so if you collect them all, you'll get a good chunk of change.

item.title: Where to get an offering fish for Jabu-Jabu in Ocarina of Time
item.description: You need to make an offering to Jabu-Jabu in Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake before you can rescue Princess Ruto . However, the game is rather vague about what constitutes an offering, though Jabu-Jabu's more devoted followers do give you a hint. Assuming you look in the right place, that is.

item.title: Critical Role Officially Returns to Its Roots for New Campaign with Hololive
item.description: Announced in October , Shattered Legends is an upcoming miniseries featuring Critical Role and members of Hololive Production. Critical Role founders Matt Mercer and Marisha Ray will team up with Hololive’s Nerissa Ravencroft, Mori Calliope, Shiori Novella, and Gigi Murin for a new adventure set in the world of Exandria , where the Critical Role story began with Campaign 1: Vox Machina .

item.title: 8 New TV Shows to Watch This Weekend on Netflix, HBO, and Apple TV (November 6 - 8)
item.description: Happy weekend! It’s an important month for some of the year’s biggest TV genre releases, from the new season of The Lord of the Rings: Rings of Power , which has been billed as a soft reboot, to the final season of Yellowjackets , to Netflix’s new exorcist-teen horror comedy The Body .

item.title: All songs in Zelda Ocarina of Time
item.description: Songs allow you to change the time of day, call your horse, literally teleport, and much more in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake. They're essential to your progress, and they're just great melodies to listen to. However, all the songs are not available to you at the start of the game. Instead, you'll need to progress in the story, and scour all of Hyrule to unlock them all.

item.title: Where to find Princess Ruto in Ocarina of Time
item.description: Finding Princess Ruto is part of the "Spiritual Stone of Water" main mission in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake. The Princess of the Zora Domain is missing, and her father, King Zora asks Link for help locating her. To complete this quest and progress through the campaign, Link must play detective and collect a few pieces of information to discover where he needs to go, which involves obtaining the Silver Scale to reach Lake Hylia .

item.title: All soft soil and Magic Bean planting locations in Ocarina of Time
item.description: Soft soil and Magic Beans go hand-in-hand in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake. You can place a bug onto soft soil, and a Gold Skulltula will pop out. But, you can also plant a Magic Bean into it as young Link, and return to it in the future to go on a whimsical journey and find some secret goodies, like Gold Skulltulas and Pieces of Heart .

item.title: All Gold Skulltula locations in Ocarina of Time
item.description: Gold Skulltulas act as a collectible in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake, but they're also needed to cure a cursed family in Kakariko Village.

item.title: Anne Hathaway and JJ Abrams Sci-Fi Thriller Sets Official HBO Max Streaming Date
item.description: If you’ve been itching for a sci-fi dinosaur flick that isn’t Jurassic Park , here’s some good news: The End of Oak Street is finally coming to HBO Max, just a few short months after its run in movie theaters. The thriller from writer-director David Robert Mitchell and producer J.J. Abrams follows a suburban American family that finds itself in the prehistoric past when their entire block is inexplicably transported into the Mesozoic Era.

item.title: Netflix Officially Removes Clint Eastwood’s R-Rated War Thriller
item.description: While Clint Eastwood is often associated with the Dirty Harry franchise and Westerns such as The Good, The Bad and The Ugly , The Outlaw Josey Wales , and Unforgiven , as a director, he's frequently explored stories of war. After directing Heartbreak Ridge in 1986, Eastwood returned to war stories in a big way in the 2000s, with back-to-back World War II movies Flags of Our Fathers and Letters from Iwo Jima .
